briefdescription.para: LiveOutPair - A value and the block that defined it.

detaileddescription.para: The domtree node is redundant, it can be computed as: MDT[Indexes.getMBBFromIndex(VNI->def)].

briefdescription.para: LiveOutMap - Map basic blocks to the value leaving the block.
Map LiveRange to sets of blocks (represented by bit vectors) that in the live range are defined on entry and undefined on entry.

detaileddescription.para: A block is defined on entry if there is a path from at least one of the defs in the live range to the entry of the block, and conversely, a block is undefined on entry, if there is no such path (i.e. no definition reaches the entry of the block). A single LiveRangeCalc object is used to track live-out information for multiple registers in live range splitting (which is ok, since the live ranges of these registers do not overlap), but the defined/undefined information must be kept separate for each individual range. By convention, EntryInfoMap[&LR] = { Defined, Undefined }.

briefdescription.para: Bit vector of active entries in LiveOut, also used as a visited set by findReachingDefs.

detaileddescription.para: One entry per basic block, indexed by block number. This is kept as a separate bit vector because it can be cleared quickly when switching live ranges.

briefdescription.para: Map each basic block where a live range is live out to the live-out value and its defining block.

detaileddescription.para: For every basic block, MBB, one of these conditions shall be true:

listitem.para: !Seen.count(MBB->getNumber()) Blocks without a Seen bit are ignored.
LiveOut[MBB].second.getNode() == MBB The live-out value is defined in MBB.
forall P in preds(MBB): LiveOut[P] == LiveOut[MBB] The live-out value passses through MBB. All predecessors must carry the same value.

detaileddescription.para: The domtree node may be null, it can be computed.
The map can be shared by multiple live ranges as long as no two are live-out of the same block.

briefdescription.para: LiveIn - Work list of blocks where the live-in value has yet to be determined.

detaileddescription.para: This list is typically computed by findReachingDefs() and used as a work list by updateSSA(). The low-level interface may also be used to add entries directly.

memberdef.name: findReachingDefs

briefdescription.para: Find the set of defs that can reach Kill.

detaileddescription.para: Kill must belong to UseMBB.
If exactly one def can reach UseMBB, and the def dominates Kill, all paths from the def to UseMBB are added to LR, and the function returns true.
If multiple values can reach UseMBB, the blocks that need LR to be live in are added to the LiveIn array, and the function returns false.

The array Undef provides the locations where the range LR becomes undefined by <def,read-undef> operands on other subranges. If Undef is non-empty and Kill is jointly dominated only by the entries of Undef, the function returns false.
PhysReg, when set, is used to verify live-in lists on basic blocks.

briefdescription.para: updateSSA - Compute the values that will be live in to all requested blocks in LiveIn.

detaileddescription.para: Create PHI-def values as required to preserve SSA form.
Every live-in block must be jointly dominated by the added live-out blocks. No values are read from the live ranges.

briefdescription.para: Transfer information from the LiveIn vector to the live ranges and update the given LiveOuts.
Some getters to expose in a read-only way some private fields to subclasses.
reset - Prepare caches for a new set of non-overlapping live ranges.

detaileddescription.para: The caches must be reset before attempting calculations with a live range that may overlap a previously computed live range, and before the first live range in a function. If live ranges are not known to be non-overlapping, call reset before each.

memberdef.name: extend

briefdescription.para: Extend the live range of LR to reach Use.

detaileddescription.para: The existing values in LR must be live so they jointly dominate Use. If Use is not dominated by a single existing value, PHI-defs are inserted as required to preserve SSA form.
PhysReg, when set, is used to verify live-in lists on basic blocks.

briefdescription.para: setLiveOutValue - Indicate that VNI is live out from MBB.

detaileddescription.para: The calculateValues() function will not add liveness for MBB, the caller should take care of that.
VNI may be null only if MBB is a live-through block also passed to addLiveInBlock().

briefdescription.para: addLiveInBlock - Add a block with an unknown live-in value.

detaileddescription.para: This function can only be called once per basic block. Once the live-in value has been determined, calculateValues() will add liveness to LI.

parameterdescription.para: The live range that is live-in to the block.
The domtree node for the block.
Index in block where LI is killed. If the value is live-through, set Kill = SLotIndex() and also call setLiveOutValue(MBB, 0).

briefdescription.para: calculateValues - Calculate the value that will be live-in to each block added with addLiveInBlock.

detaileddescription.para: Add PHI-def values as needed to preserve SSA form. Add liveness to all live-in blocks up to the Kill point, or the whole block for live-through blocks.
Every predecessor of a live-in block must have been given a value with setLiveOutValue, the value may be null for live-trough blocks.
